We're looking for an Associate Account Director to drive RetailNext's commercial growth across EMEA, with a focus on our expanding markets in Germany. This is an early-career commercial role for someone who wants to learn the full sales cycle from the inside — building pipeline, supporting deals end to end, helping existing customers grow, and lending a hand on marketing in-region.
You'll work directly with our regional sales leadership and partner closely with our Head of EMEA, who provides commercial and customer guidance across the region. The right person is hungry, organized, and proactive: comfortable picking up the phone, chasing leads, and creating commercial momentum without waiting to be asked. You're energized by closing the gap between a prospect and a customer, and you care about getting the details right.
This is a launchpad role for someone who wants a career in sales. You'll get broad commercial exposure in a fast-growing market, with real runway to grow into a quota-carrying sales role as you find your footing.
Reports to: Head of Sales (dotted line to Head of EMEA)
Location: Remote — based in Germany, with the right to work in-region

Pipeline Generation & Outbound
Own targeted outbound outreach to identify, qualify, and book meetings with new prospects across Germany
Research target accounts and build prioritized prospect lists aligned to regional growth goals
Follow up relentlessly on inbound and marketing-generated leads to keep the top of the funnel healthy
Track outreach activity, conversion, and pipeline contribution against clear targets
Sales Support & Deal Execution
Keep the regional sales team and the Head of EMEA moving on day-to-day commercial activity — preparing materials, tracking follow-ups, and pushing deals toward close
Prepare proposals, quotes, and customer-facing presentations for the German markets
Keep CRM records and pipeline data accurate and up to date
Coordinate logistics for customer meetings, demos, and regional sales activity
Existing Customers & Partner Support
Track relationships with existing EMEA customers, surface renewal and expansion signals, and help the sales team act on them
Coordinate joint activity with regional partners and keep those relationships running smoothly
Marketing Support
Contribute to regional marketing efforts — events, campaigns, and localized content for the German markets
Help coordinate RetailNext's presence at regional trade shows and customer events
Feed on-the-ground insight back to the marketing team on what resonates in-region

Required
Some experience in a sales, business development, or commercial role — early-career welcome, but you should be excited about a sales career
Comfortable and confident with outbound outreach: cold calls, emails, and talking to prospects and customers
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep deals and follow-ups on track
Excellent written and verbal communication
Based in Germany with the right to work in-region; local language fluency strongly preferred
Proactive, self-directed working style suited to a remote role

Direct exposure to RetailNext's EMEA sales leadership and Head of EMEA from day one
A structured runway into a quota-carrying sales role as you build your track record
Rare early-career breadth: outbound, deal support, existing-customer growth, and marketing, all in one seat
Monthly Recharge Day
Holiday Exchange Program

Medical Insurance
Work from Anywhere up to 90 days

Als Account Executive übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Skalierung von JobAuto, indem du potenzielle Partnerunternehmen für unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit Programm JobAuto gewinnst. Dabei bist du für den gesamten Sales Cycle, von Leadgenerierung bis zu Account Closing verantwortlich.

Mit JobAuto richten wir uns an Unternehmen aller Größenordnungen, die ihren Mitarbeitern den Umstieg auf (Elektro-)Mobilität durch Gehaltsumwandlung erleichtern wollen.

Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Vertrieb, einem ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und Blick für die Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen entwickelst du gemeinsam mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Stakeholder wertstiftende Lösungen und bringst die Verhandlungen zu erfolgreichem Abschluss.

Damit hast du maßgeblichen Einfluss auf den Erfolg und das Wachstum unserer JobAuto Unit.

Land & Expand: Dein Ziel ist es, unser Produkt bei neuen Geschäftskund:innen zu platzieren und damit die optimale Basis für den langfristigen Ausbau von Key Accounts zu legen. Dafür etablierst du tiefgreifende Beziehungen mit wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern auf VP- und C-Level Ebene.
Steuere den gesamten Sales-Cycle: Du bist von der aktiven Leadgenerierung über die Qualifizierung bis zum Closing komplett für die Gewinnung von JobAuto-Kund:innen verantwortlich. Dabei hast du die Möglichkeit, neue Verkaufsstrategien für die Gewinnung von Outbound Leads einzubringen.
Kenne den Markt und unser Produkt: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Angebot im Bereich Mobilitätsmanagement und wirst zum Experten für den Markt der Gehaltsumwandlung für Autoabos und unser Angebot.
Entwickle das JobAuto Produkt weiter: Du bist in stetigem Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen, sammelst Feedback und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale, um unser Produkt und die JobAuto Customer Journey kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. So stellst du sicher, dass wir Marktchancen optimal nutzen, Prozesse verbessern und unsere Kundenzufriedenheit kontinuierlich steigern.
Your Profile
Erfolgreicher Abschluss eines (Bachelor-) Studiums oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
Du hast 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Vertrieb mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im Verkauf komplexer Unternehmenslösungen. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in der Nutzung von HubSpot oder anderen CRM-Tools.
Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und überzeugst auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen durch deine exzellenten Argumentations- und Networking-Fähigkeiten.
Du zeigst Bias for Action und hast Lust, unsere JobAuto Sales Unit maßgeblich mitzuentwickeln.
Dein unternehmerisches Denken macht dich zum kompetenten Ansprechpartner, der mit potentiellen Kund:innen gemeinsam Lösungen erarbeitet. Du hast außerdem Freude daran, Dir auch neue Aufgabenbereiche anzueignen, um JobAuto voranzutreiben.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und souverän Englisch.

Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.
Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.
Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 % .
Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing) .
Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support.
Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München . On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch - Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen .
Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.

FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 50 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor.
Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.
Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!

This is a remote role covering the West Coast territory, sitting within a US sales team of around ten people and reporting directly to the VP of Sales, North America. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and qualification through to close — for new enterprise accounts in your territory. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and Legal to bring the right resources to bear at the right moments in each deal.
Why emnify
IoT connectivity is moving from fragmented, carrier-dependent infrastructure toward cloud-native platforms — and emnify is at the front of that shift. The US market is a genuine growth priority, not an afterthought, and this territory represents real, buildable opportunity.

You will be selling a product with strong technical differentiation into a buyer community that is actively looking for a better answer than what legacy telcos offer. The deals are complex and meaningful, the internal team is lean and collaborative, and the company has hit a series of significant milestones that signal strong commercial momentum.

If you want a role where your territory performance is visible and your contribution matters, this is it.

Drive new enterprise revenue across the West Coast territory, owning every stage of the sales cycle from first contact to signed contract
Build a disciplined, data-driven pipeline using a structured qualification framework and rigorous CRM hygiene, so your forecast is reliable and your activity is repeatable
Own commercial negotiations — pricing, competitive positioning, business case development, and contracting — coordinating internal stakeholders to move deals forward
Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and influencers across Line of Business Management, Product, Operations, and Procurement within target accounts
Establish a sustainable territory strategy: a clear account prioritisation plan, consistent prospecting motion, and a pipeline that covers future quota periods, not just the current quarter
What We Expect
A proven track record of closing complex B2B SaaS or technology deals at the enterprise level, with consistent quota attainment
Experience managing and closing deals with ARR above $100k, including navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes and extended sales cycles
Fluency in a structured sales methodology — MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, or similar — and the discipline to apply it consistently rather than selectively
Comfort operating in a value-based selling motion: you build business cases, you quantify ROI, and you sell outcomes rather than features
Proficiency with CRM and sales tools (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalents) and a genuine preference for a data-driven approach to managing your territory
Clear, confident written and verbal communication — you can adapt your message for a technical buyer, a procurement lead, or a C-suite sponsor
Coachability — we want someone who is excited to grow with us
Your First 6 Months
In your first few weeks , the priority is depth over activity. You will complete onboarding, work through product and technical training, and develop a solid grasp of emnify's ideal customer profile, buyer personas, pricing model, and competitive positioning.
By month two or three , you will be prospecting independently — running outbound alongside inbound follow-up, conducting your own discovery calls, and qualifying opportunities against emnify's framework. You will start building pipeline and learning which messages and objections resonate with our buyers. Expect to be generating meetings and managing early-stage opportunities with increasing independence.
By the halfway mark , you should own a live set of opportunities at multiple stages of the funnel. You will be running complete discovery and demo cycles, coordinating Solutions Engineering and other internal resources, producing a reliable forecast, and progressing late-stage deals toward close. Depending on sales-cycle length, this is when first wins typically become possible.
The broader arc is becoming a repeatable, forecastable contributor — someone with a clear territory strategy, consistent prospecting habits, strong internal relationships, and a sharp understanding of why deals are won or lost.
Why It Might Not Be a Match
If you prefer a highly structured, process-heavy environment with clearly defined playbooks at every step, you may find emnify's pace and degree of self-direction uncomfortable — we are still building, and we expect this person to help shape how things are done, not just follow an established script
If you are most comfortable managing a high volume of smaller, transactional deals, the complexity and longer timelines of enterprise IoT sales cycles may not suit your natural rhythm
If you need a large, well-resourced support organisation around you before you feel confident going to market, this role will feel underpowered — the team is lean, which means high ownership and real impact, but also real ambiguity

Job Description About ScholarshipOwl
ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S. , connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.
We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

Reports to: Director of Sales
Compensation: Strong base salary + uncapped commission structure with clear accelerators for over-performance.
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Account Executive (Full Cycle) to take strong ownership of our revenue growth through consistent, targeted outbound prospecting and strategic closing. This is a high-impact, mid-to-senior level role designed for a true "hunter" who thrives on turning cold opportunities into high-quality, long-term B2B clients for our SSC and Pro product lines.
This role runs in two gears : sharp and disciplined in creating pipeline — targeted, creative outbound to a defined ICP, disciplined qualification, and efficiently filtering out deals that aren't a fit — and consultative once you're in the room, where discovery and product education come before the pitch and multi-stakeholder deals are won on understanding, not pressure.
In this role, you won't just wait for inbound leads—you will own the entire sales lifecycle . From dedicated outbound prospecting and strategic qualification to leading compelling product demos and closing complex deals, you will drive the pipeline that fuels our expansion. If you are motivated by building a robust book of business from scratch and find purpose in driving net-new revenue, you’ll thrive in this position.
What You'll Be Selling
Sponsored Scholarship Campaigns (SSC) — Our flagship product, and a performance marketing channel rather than a philanthropy program. It's built on the foundation of something Gen Z is already looking for: scholarships, not ads. The brand earns the next generation of customers, and students earn financial aid.

We build the campaign with the client and run the scholarship end to end, so the brand reaches a US Gen Z audience through a channel that's permission-based by design rather than interruptive, and generates first-party, opt-in insights at scale .
What that solves varies by client, and learning to read which version you're selling is a real part of the job: customer and user acquisition, lead generation, recruiting pipeline, content, or serious brand engagement with the next generation of buyers. Your buyer is typically a Growth Manager or marketing lead at a brand or agency that sells to Gen Z, and you're competing for performance marketing budget against paid social and search, not against other scholarship platforms.
ScholarshipOwl Pro — Scholarship management for organizations already running their own scholarship programs in cumbersome or inefficient ways: shorter cycle, more operational, philanthropic buyer , and a second motion alongside SSC.

Relentless Prospecting: Execute high-volume daily outbound campaigns (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to hunt for net-new opportunities and consistently book discovery meetings .
Full-Cycle Ownership: Run the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and aggressive qualification to running product demos, sending proposals, and closing deals .
Data-Driven Pipeline Triage: Actively manage your sales funnel within HubSpot, performing regular pipeline reviews to prioritize high-value opportunities and ruthlessly cut weak leads .
Drive Revenue & Velocity: Take absolute ownership of your targets, driving urgency in deal cycles to progress opportunities through late-stage negotiations and contract signing.
Hit Major Milestones: Our sales cycle runs four to six months, so your first quarter is about building. Deliver $175–300K in qualified pipeline (approx. 20–30 qualified meetings ) in your first 90 days , and close your first net-new deal within six months .
Iterate & Optimize: Continuously refine your outreach messaging and campaign targeting based on performance metrics to maximize conversion rates.
